title: B2B Company & Tech Stack Enricher Input

startUrls.title: Target Website URLs / Domains
startUrls.description: List of company websites or domain URLs to enrich. Accepts standard URLs (e.g., https://apify.com, https://stripe.com).

extractTechStack.title: Detect Tech Stack
extractTechStack.description: Identify website technologies (CMS, eCommerce, frontend frameworks, analytics, CRM, payments, and hosting).

extractContacts.title: Extract Public Contacts
extractContacts.description: Extract publicly visible email addresses and phone numbers.

extractSocials.title: Extract Social Profiles
extractSocials.description: Extract social media links (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, GitHub, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube).

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Domains to Process
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of domains to process in a single run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for reliable crawling. Default uses Apify Proxy.
